headline: Return of Democrats to US Congress will pressure Mexico on labor commitments in USMCA
summary: Specialists say the Democratic victory in US midterm elections could bring greater demands on Mexico over labour rights, union freedom and collective bargaining under the USMCA.
why: The USMCA (T-MEC) is the trade agreement among the United States, Mexico and Canada, and its labour provisions can affect trade terms and Mexican manufacturing costs.
original_headline: Retorno de Demócratas al Congreso de EU presionará a México en compromisos laborales del T-MEC
